card.name: La in names and starting words
card.fires_on: The word La (or la) when it begins a proper name or a Romance-language title, such as La Jolla, La Casa Rosada or La Calprenède. It also fires on la at the start of words like laundries or launched.

modes.label: La in place and person names
modes.description: Capitalized La beginning a name of a place, work or person, often in Spanish or French.

modes.label: la starting an English word
modes.description: The letters la that begin a longer English word, such as laundries or launched.
modes.example: <<la>>unched our family into an emotional odyssey

modes.label: Name-linking words near classical authors
modes.description: A linking word or period inside a citation or name list of old authors, just before another name.

card.plain: It marks the start of a name or word beginning with La, mostly Spanish or French names.
